title: Kusukela Ekujuleni Komthombo
intro: Uhambo lomphefumulo osemusha lwaqala ngombono onamandla wezidalwa zasezulwini zikhothama ngenhlonipho. Impilo yalo muntu yaphawulwa ukukhashelwa okujulile kwalabo abaseduze, kwalandelwa iminyaka yokugqilazwa nokuboshwa ngokungemthetho. Kodwa ngokholo olungantengantengi nesiqondiso saphezulu, lo muntu wasuka emgodini ophansi kakhulu waba ngomunye wabantu abanamandla kakhulu embusweni omkhulu. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola ukuthi ungubani lo mkhonzi omangalisayo ka-Allah?
clues: Ngaboniswa umbono wezinkanyezi eziyishumi nanye, ilanga, nenyanga zikhothama phambi kwami
Ngangingumntwana othandekayo kakhulu womzali wami, okwadala umona phakathi kwabafowethu
Ngabanjwa abafowethu, ngakhunyulwa ingubo yami, ngafaka emthonjeni ojulile nomnyama.
Ngathengiswa njengempahla emakethe futhi ngathuthwa ngayiswa kude nezwe lakithi
Owesifazane onamandla wazama ukunginika udumo, futhi ngaphonswa ejele ngenxa yokwenqaba ukushelwa kwakhe
Ngabusiswa ngesipho sokuhumusha amaphupho, futhi ngavuka ekubeni yisiboshwa esikhohliwe ngaba yinduna enkulu yaseGibhithe

options: URose waba ngungqongqoshe omkhulu waseGibhithe futhi wahlangana nomndeni wakhe othandekayo
Wakha umkhumbi omkhulu futhi wabizela abantu ekukholweni
Wahola isizwe sonke wasikhulula ebugqilini eGibhithe
Wanikwa isineke ngenxa yokugula okukhulu futhi welashwa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
